analysis: Examined both docs/developer/test.md excerpts and the supplied change map/patch. Head line 3 changes only the date. The added Add-On Hold section (head lines 767–787 visible in the patch) documents real AF_UNIX/flock tests, owner-only records, peer refusal, socket limits, bounded model draining, lease expiry, restart restoration, and busy fields across heartbeat/register/reconnect. No executable control is changed in this unit, and the documentation does not establish a concrete regression. Existing test guidance retains state isolation, authenticated local serving, encrypted coordinator requests, artifact verification, cache safeguards (T-041), and limits on attestation/qualification claims (T-052–T-057). Integration should examine the actual add-on IPC peer authorization and runtime-path ownership against TB-003, drain/cancellation and retained native ownership against TB-007/T-010, and busy/register/reconnect interactions against TB-002/T-053. The section's final peer-check qualification is truncated, and the relevant implementations are not supplied here; documented test coverage cannot verify those controls or settle the security of the new local IPC surface. This is a coverage limitation, not a finding against the documentation.
